restates permission areas in local literals; import them from enterprise/permissions.

The bridge names TIMEOUT, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE and INVALID_RESPONSE as its own transport codes instead of importing ErrorCode from @agiworkforce/types, so a renderer maps a host failure onto a code the server never uses.
entries.fix: Import ErrorCode and raise its members; add a transport class to the shared taxonomy if none of them fits.

entries.why: The unavailable screen restates entitlement, permission and policy to choose its copy, so a fourth control layer added to the registry renders the wrong sentence on mobile.
entries.fix: Import CONTROL_LAYERS and key the copy off it.

entries.why: The Tauri app's chat store keeps its own citation row (index, timestamp) with the url, title and snippet fields; extend AgentEventSource when that store next changes.
Held by the Codex mobile release; the stream's sources field becomes AgentEventSource[] in the post-codex pass.
The chip's props spell out index, title, url and snippet one by one; take an AgentEventSource prop plus the index instead.
